description: NHFLOW semi-implicit step with the non-hydrostatic pressure (A 510 12, A 520 2): the coupled eta-phi system after Basilisk's multilayer solver (Keller box, phi on the layer interfaces). First sloshing mode in a closed 1 m tank, kh = 2, 32 cells, 4 sigma layers, dt = T/40; period error 1.4e-3 against linear theory (Basilisk: 1.8e-3).
covers: nhflow_momentum_SI_nh: nh_residual, nh_faces (Basilisk hpg), Keller box constraint, band LU
face_update with the non-hydrostatic layer discharges
